title: Right-edge vertical pager: a black bar, acid to-previous and to-next marks around the current number set sideways, the next number half visible
use: The fixed section pager on the right edge of a long page or a game menu. current and next are two-digit numbers.
relations: Bar 46 units wide, round inner corners (12), bleeding off the right edge.
Current number acid, sideways, between the two acid marks; the next number white, cut by the bar's bottom.

provenance.corpus: replay-ward case (回放街区 REPLAY WARD): our own original one-page game site and two in-game screens in the street-tape grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/street-tape/style.json provenance (reference board measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: Measured on the board: bar 46 px wide, 263-268 px visible, acid part 150 px; the case's pager is the same.
measured: Board: black bar 46 x 263 at the right edge, acid marks and number 28 x 150 px.
Case: the pager stays readable at 390 wide scaled to 0.75.
